title: Work tape head movement
statement: For any Boolean input word $y$, states $st,st'$, natural numbers $i,k,p$, integer head position $q$, and sign $mv\in\{-1,0,1\}$, applying the action that leaves the input head fixed, moves work tape $2$ by $mv$, and enters state $st'$ to the configuration in state $st$ with head position $q$ on tape $2$ gives the configuration in state $st'$ with head position $q+mv$ on tape $2$.
